sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
BOM-LINE 110: part BR-180 (drawing Rev F); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6061-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: Meccanica C has an OPEN 8D on cracks at fastener holes in EN AW-6061-T6 parts. BR-180 is 6061-T6 with 4 fastener holes. The root cause is not confirmed and a material contribution is not excluded. The probation was revoked, but the 8D stays open, so the volume move to C is blocked on this issue.
